question: Approve this jurisdiction-refactor design to enter implementation?

artifacts.summary: Move review-finding classification into the active workflow and interpose First Officer authorization before finding-driven candidate edits, commits, or reruns. The revised design separates six authorities, preserves four-field evidence with mechanical field-3 citations, cuts the baseline to 10 files/187 insertions, and relies on retained one-host evidence without inventing recorder state or permanent live-scenario plumbing.
